name.description: Name of the API, used in documentation and generated type prefixes.

version.description: API version segment, for example v1.

base_path.description: Prefix every route sits under, for example /api/v1.

permissions.description: Whether generated handlers check a permission derived from the resource and operation. Defaults to derived.

search_method.description: How the Search operation is exposed. Defaults to both: QUERY with a POST alias.

expose.description: Foundation tables to generate a model, repository, and API for anyway.

own.description: Generate for every foundation table, for a project that has forked the schema and no longer imports rig/auth.

image.description: Container image for the throwaway database.

port.description: Host port the throwaway database listens on.

password.description: Database password. This is a local throwaway database; do not put a real secret here.

schema.description: Postgres schema to read. Defaults to public.

url.description: Connection URL of an existing database. Set this to skip the throwaway container entirely.

name.description: Registered generator name, for example persist-go.

out_dir.description: Output directory, relative to the project root.

options.description: Generator-specific options. Each generator publishes its own schema for this block.

table_dir.description: Directory for a table's configuration and service code. Templates: {table} {Table} {tables}.

config_file.description: Path to a table's configuration file. May reference {table_dir}.

table.description: Name of the migration bookkeeping table.

json_case.description: Shape of generated JSON keys. Defaults to camel.

initialisms.description: Extra acronyms that stay uppercase in Go identifiers, for example SCB.

plurals.description: Plural overrides keyed by table name, for the words English inflection gets wrong.

version.description: OpenAPI specification version. 3.1 documents the POST alias for Search; 3.2 emits QUERY natively.

module.description: Go module path of the application, used to build generated import paths.

unmentioned_column.description: A column exists in the database but is not mentioned in its table configuration.

missing_comment.description: A table or column has no comment.

fk_needs_index.description: A foreign-key column is not covered by an index.

tenant_id_leading_index.description: No index leads with the tenant column.

boolean_prefix.description: A boolean column does not read as a predicate.

timestamp_suffix.description: A timestamp column is not named _at, or an _at column is not a timestamptz. A name ending in _at claims the column records when something happened, and only timestamptz can: a bare timestamp is a clock reading with nothing to anchor it.

date_suffix.description: A date column is not named _date, or a _date column is not a date.

fk_naming.description: A foreign-key column is not named after the table it references.

cascade_delete.description: A foreign key declares ON DELETE CASCADE.

migration_filename.description: A migration file is not named NNNNN_snake_case.sql.

project.description: Identity of the application being generated.

layout.description: Where table configuration and generated code live.

api.description: Shape of the generated HTTP API.

database.description: Where to run migrations and read the schema from.

auth.description: How the authentication foundation's tables are treated.

naming.description: How database names become Go and JSON names.

validate.description: Severity of each configurable convention rule.

title: rig project configuration
description: Project-wide configuration: layout, database, naming, convention severities, and the generators to run.
